tools.loudness: BS.1770 K-weighted integrated via pyloudnorm Meter(48000)
tools.player: Python simulation of PLAYER_RULES.md (scripts in fable_study_v1/scripts); Catmull-Rom interpolation

tested_ranges.speed_grid_mps: 0.5 to 40 step 0.5, plus quarter offsets 0.75 to 39.75

checks.loop_wrap_listened: not done (no listening possible in this environment); a small wrap step does not prove a seamless loop
checks.steady_components_independent_lengths: deliberate departure: every steady tone and sideband loop is identical to its sweep counterpart (3.6 s, integer periods) so read heads stay aligned; see README
checks.steady_composite_repetition_over_30s: not perceptually verified; the 30 s holds in preview1/preview2 exist for that judgement; component c is a 4.0 s loop and necessarily repeats
checks.settings_keys_and_rule_strings_complete: pass (all template keys present; lists updated explicitly; see INTEGRATION.md)

named_exceptions: departure onset 0.5 to 1.5 m/s: power layers fade in from silence (a real onset, not a table defect)
brake fade-in 1.5 to 4 m/s mirrors the electrical brake letting go at low speed
steady fade guard 4.5 to 5 m/s is below eligibility and excluded from the steady step assessment
pattern changes at 11, 24 and 28 m/s are deliberate pitch steps; their loudness was matched across the crossfade
steady_fraction_in_previews: detector-driven by the documented rules applied to the scenario speed inside the simulation; not the game's classifier

measured: power 0 to about 20 m/s (Fruitvale, Lake Merritt, Coliseum departures; axis inferred from 1.3 m/s² and the 11 m/s dip)
slowing 40 to 28 m/s (user-identified glide) and 28 to 26 m/s (pattern C)
cruise at 40 m/s (user anchor) and a faint cruise whine near 19 m/s
rolling noise at about 9, 19 and 40 m/s
inferred_or_extrapolated: cruising tone below 19 m/s and 24 to 28 m/s
level versus speed of the mechanical background between anchors, and its component balance
all m/s values except the 40 m/s anchor
not_covered: friction-brake warble and squeal (excluded on purpose)

approval.listening: not obtained for the pack; only study candidate A (departure whine) is approved
approval.ogg_encoding: not performed; recheck loops and peaks after conversion

known_limitations: no listening by the builder; every check is numeric
mechanical background is designed; only its total level versus speed is calibrated against the recording
cruise-family timbre reused for powered 28 to 40 m/s
K-weighted loudness of pitched layers changes with pitch; rows were calibrated at their own pitch but between rows the player interpolates linearly
